title: Marco-MoE: Open Multilingual MoE Models by Alibaba AIDC
summary: A series of hyper-sparse Mixture-of-Experts models designed for efficient multilingual performance. Developed by Alibaba AIDC, these models activate only 5-7.5% of their parameters per token to run fast on consumer hardware.
research_notes: Introduced the CulturAll benchmark for multilingual evaluation; best deployed via vLLM to handle tied embedding layers correctly.

evolution.summary: Originally based on dense Qwen models, the project evolved using Fine-grained Sub-matrix Splitting and Drop-Upcycling. Current iterations like Marco-Mini-Global support 64 languages and target underserved linguistic communities.
